def transform(grid):
    """Map the dominant color to the sole minority color, and the minority to 0."""
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    minority = next(cell for cell in counts if cell != background)
    return [[0 if cell == minority else minority for cell in row] for row in grid]
